fact: Article 384 of the Congolese Digital Code makes digital start-ups with entrepreneur status eligible for the tax, para-fiscal, customs and exchange advantages of the legislation on entrepreneurship and start-ups, per We are Tech.

ACP quotes a digital specialist saying the DRC Startup Act is still being finalised, with four draft decrees adopted in May 2025 to operationalise tax, customs and exchange advantages of a 2022 ordonnance-loi still in preparation per a 3 August 2026 communique.
The DRC has a Startup Act, ordonnance-loi n 22/030 of 8 September 2022, whose article 50 gives startups tax advantages (Ministry of Finance communique).

DecryptEco reports that ordonnance-loi n°22/030 of 8 September 2022 provides a framework for promoting entrepreneurship, start-ups and SMEs, and that article 384 of the Code du numérique makes start-ups with entreprenant status eligible for tax, customs and exchange advantages.
